Apple’s iPad mini hits best price in months from $399 for Prime Day (Nearly $100 off)

Day 2 of the 2026 Amazon Prime Day sale is now live with a loads of new discounts. One of which is this near $100 price drop on the most affordable current-generation Apple iPad mini from $399 – it has been a long while since we have seen a solid deal on the mini.

As part of its Prime Day sale, Amazon is now offering the latest iPad mini starting from $399.99 shipped in all four colors. Regular $499, this is just shy of $100 off the list price and the best we can find.

Apple’s iPad mini has been down this low before, but we have been waiting on a solid deal for months now. With many of the configurations being out of stock for last few months, Amazon has replenished its mini offerings and is now delivering solid deals for Prime Day:

  • iPad mini 128GB $399 (Reg. $499)
  • iPad mini 256GB $499 (Reg. $599)
  • iPad mini 512GB $699 (Reg. $799)

We did catch this same price drop a few times earlier in the year, but even then stock was limited. Much like we have seen with the Mac mini lately, the venerable iPad mini has become somewhat hard to come by with a solid discount – they are at a passable $50 off in the Best Buy Tech Fest sale right now.

Giant $150 price drop hits 2026 AirPods Max 2 to deliver new Prime Day all-time low (All colors)

Amazon Prime Day is now live and the deals are already wild – the new 2026 Apple AirPods Max 2 headphones are now at a, frankly, giant $150 off.

Amazon is now offering AirPods Max 2 down at $399 shipped. Regularly $549, this is a straight up $150 price drop and the best deal we have tracked by a long shot.

The $150 discount we are tracking here today is now live on all five colors – we featured this deal in the middle of the night (early this morning) when it first went live, but select color options kept bumping in and out of stock, or jumping in price. Everything seems to have settled now, at least to some degree, with all five up for grabs at the lowest price to date.

We were hoping to see AirPods Max remain at the $100 off range for Prime Day this year, but $150 off is somewhat surprising. It is Prime Day after all, and nothing is safe, but this is also a brand new flagship release from Apple not much more than 4 months old at this point, and the $399 is $50 under the initial early Prime Day deal we spotted. Whether or not this deal sticks around for the next 4 days remains to be seen, but it is up for grabs right now.
